# UPD-003: Unattended upgrades include the security pocket

- **Group:** Updates
- **Severity when it fails:** high
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

The allowed origins decide what is installed automatically. Without the security pocket the tool runs and does nothing about security fixes.

## Verify by hand

```sh
apt-config dump Unattended-Upgrade::Allowed-Origins
```

## How to fix it

Include `${distro_id}:${distro_codename}-security` (Debian: `origin=Debian,codename=${distro_codename}-security`) in Unattended-Upgrade::Allowed-Origins.

Run `stackward explain UPD-003` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
